verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents an official MCP server guide for running browser automation tasks from AI coding assistants, naming Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client, and a probe confirmed the page exists. A community comment saying it lacked MCP integration appears to predate this documentation, so it does not concretely contradict the current server. Missing for 10: details on exposed tools, setup and auth in the evidence, and independent hands-on confirmation that the server works.
